visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins outdoors on a lush green lawn. A middle-aged woman with short black hair is wearing a white t-shirt with the brand name 'MARDI' and a black graphic. She looks slightly contemplative. A young man with glasses and a black sweatshirt labeled 'PITTSBURGH' enters the frame, talking directly to the camera while gesturing. (2) The scene shifts to the exterior of a modern two-story residential building with a grey and black facade. A black metal gate and a sign for 'STUDIO M OPEN HOUSE' are visible near the sidewalk. The lighting is bright under a partly cloudy sky. (3) The interior tour begins in a spacious, modern dining and kitchen area. A large dark dining table features a bouquet of flowers. Minimalist pendant lights hang from a high ceiling. The brother, wearing a tan t-shirt, leads the way through the hallway. (4) Transition to a clean, white-tiled laundry room with black cabinetry. The brother points towards a glass door that opens to a backyard. The backyard features a manicured lawn, a swimming pool, and a covered BBQ area with outdoor furniture. (5) Upstairs, the camera captures a media room with a large TV and a beige sectional sofa. The tour continues through several bedrooms, each featuring neutral-toned carpets, minimalist wardrobes, and en-suite bathrooms with marble-patterned tiles and modern fixtures. (6) The main bedroom is showcased, featuring a large bed, a massive window with grey curtains, and an expansive walk-in closet with floor-to-ceiling mirrors. The final scene shows the woman looking out from a bathroom window into a wooded area, appearing impressed.
